3

Identity scoring

Per track: up to 15 largest/most-confident crops are tried, embedding stops after 5 succeed. YOLO only gives a full-body box — ArcFace re-detects the face inside it, and that inner region is what's actually cosine-compared, not the body crop. The best 3 of those comparisons are averaged. Teal-outlined cards are the ones used in that average.

Appearance grouping

Matched tracks' detections merge into disjoint time windows — a new window starts if the gap exceeds 1.5s.

0s10.5s

Appearance 1: 0.0s → 10.5s · tracks [1, 2] · 48 evidence frames sampled for Phase 2

6

Evidence frames sent to Phase 2

Evenly-sampled, green-boxed “TARGET” frames actually shown to the VLM. Only frames individually scored in Step 3 carry a similarity readout — most of these 48 were never scored on their own.

!

Both Track 1 and Track 2 passed the identity threshold, so both are treated as “the target.” 26 frames carry the TARGET box on Track 1 and 22 carry it on Track 2 — at 34 shared moments both people are in frame together, so the model sees two differently-labeled copies of the same scene. Confirmed from the crops: these are two different individuals, not the same person re-tracked.

Track 1 (reference match) Track 2 (also matched)
